text:
emma_sales: Uploading the pen test + vuln-scan bundle for NimbusHealth. S3 path: s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-18/pt-scan-bundle.zip. Checksums in the bucket: SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (full file attached). Please confirm we've got everything the customer's legal team expects.

ops-bot: s3 upload complete for s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-18/pt-scan-bundle.zip (object size: 48.3 MB).

emma_sales: Customer asked for a remediation timeline and a risk-tiered list they can attach to their audit. Can security triage and give an owner + ETA per finding?

raj_security: Got it — will triage. Quick Q: did the pen test include authenticated checks? I see both unauth and auth reports in the bundle but want to confirm.

emma_sales: Yes — auth checks included. The README in the zip has creds for the test service account and a mapping.csv linking vuln IDs to endpoints.

maria_engineering: I started mapping the top-5 high findings to PRs. Two have open branches: GH: redwood/runtime#782 and redwood/auth#129 — aiming for patch deploy in next sprint. ETA: 2026-03-25 for code + 2026-03-28 for canary deploy.

raj_security: Thanks. I'll produce a risk-tier table for the customer: Critical (CVE/CWE + exploit path), High (priv escalation, auth bypass), Medium (info leakage), Low (config). Will label each finding and assign owners.

security-scanner-bot: Static scan summary attached: 14 high, 23 medium, 41 low. Dynamic auth scans: 3 high, 7 medium. Report IDs: SCAN-2026-0318-01, PT-2026-0318-A.

nick_sre: For any infrastructure fixes tagged "sre" — please include runbook changes. If we need kernel or package updates I'll schedule a maintenance window 2026-03-27 03:00-05:00 UTC.

raj_security: Emma — I'll send a spreadsheet with columns: finding_id, title, severity, cwe, exploitability, owner, owner_team, remediation_eta, evidence_s3_path, public_status. Expect first pass by EOD today.

emma_sales: Perfect. Customer asked for checksums for the artifacts too — here's a suggested verification snippet to share:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-18/pt-scan-bundle.zip ./
sha256sum pt-scan-bundle.zip
```
Return value should match: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...

maria_engineering: FYI mapped two findings to runtime PR 782: "improper bounds check in tokenizer" and "cache key collision leading to potential request poisoning". I'll add notes to the PR with sample requests and the failing testcases.

raj_security: First pass spreadsheet uploaded: s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-18/nimbus-remediation-plan.csv. I've assigned provisional owners to all High/Critical items — please review.

emma_sales: Linking that to the customer: "We've attached the remediation plan and timelines. We're treating the two critical findings as top priority and will patch + canary by 2026-03-28. Remaining highs aimed for 2026-04-05." I'll send an update after you confirm owners. :thumbsup:

nick_sre: Confirmed I'll own infra-related items 6, 9, 11 in the sheet. Adding maintenance window to calendar.

raj_security: Noted. Two action items for eng: (1) add unit tests referenced in the sheet, (2) include proof-of-fix artifacts (diff + test runs) in evidence S3 path. We'll require those before we mark an item as "resolved" for the customer audit.

emma_sales: Thanks — planning a sync with the customer's security lead Thursday 2026-03-19 16:00 PT. I'll include the remediation plan + S3 artifact checksums. Anyone want to join?

maria_engineering: Can join the first 20 min to walk through the code changes.

raj_security: I'll join too and present the risk-tiering.

emma_sales: Great — I'll send the invite. Closing the thread for now but will post updates as items move to done.
